B_native_error: During B blend capture, pin SHA of each actual bulk chunk. Per-layer analysis replays identical H/M/S batch geometry and BF16 operations, requiring identical bulk SHA, then measures actual B bulk-vs-exact error. B fused D96 dot shares SP warp/FMA order.
SP_margin: JSON sp_error separately measures SP arithmetic error on every B/C activation. E uses max(sp_error.max), never B cuBLAS-only errors; native-arm error remains JSON error and primary margin table.
